en: A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a small town or village surrounded by forests and farmland. A winding main road passes through a cluster of detached houses with steep roofs and some larger buildings. Fields and open countryside stretch into the distance, bordered by dense coniferous woods. There are no visible mountains or coastline, and no text is visible on the image.
